title: Stochastic Processes
motto: Randomness with structure. The math behind random walks, Markov chains, and diffusion models.

steps.title: Core idea
steps.body: Randomness with structure. The math behind random walks, Markov chains, and diffusion models.

steps.title: Why this matters
cards: Many AI systems involve randomness that evolves over time. Not static randomness -- structured, sequential randomness where each step depends on what came before.
Language models generate tokens one at a time. Each token depends on the previous context. The model outputs a probability distribution, samples from it, and moves on. That is a stochastic process.

steps.title: The concept
steps.body: Markov chains: next state depends only on current. PageRank and RL policies are Markov processes.
